schema.name: image_gen

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image, decide it based on the user's request. Defaults to 'auto'. 1:1 for square (icons, profiles), 16:9 for wide (landscapes, cinematic), 9:16 for tall (phone wallpapers, stories), 3:2 for horizontal photos, 2:3 for vertical (portraits, posters).

schema.description: Generate a new image from a text description using Imagine; returns the saved image's absolute path. When telling the user where it was saved, refer to it by its short session-relative path (e.g. `images/1.jpg`) rather than the absolute path, so it renders as a clickable link that opens the image. To produce multiple images, emit multiple tool calls with distinct prompts.
